attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the 10.100.42.0/24 private network it shares with node2/node3, implemented via Ansible run from the designated control node (node4). node1 answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.42.11) via a VyOS static-host-mapping served through pdns_recursor, and forwards all other queries upstream to 10.100.42.1. node2 and node3 were reconfigured (systemd-networkd DNS=/Domains=~./UseDNS=no) to resolve exclusively through node1. Verified end-to-end: inventory.internal resolves to node2's IP on both clients, public domains (example.com) resolve via forwarding. All 4 managed nodes were restarted one at a time via native safe reboot; boot_id changes proved each restart, and DNS configuration/functionality (plus a final idempotent Ansible re-run from node4) were confirmed intact after every restart.
